goal.name: C
goal.valid_for: Standard C (C17/C23) with GCC or Clang
goal.video_language_note: English: Bro Code's short topic videos and others. Hindi: CodeWithHarry topic videos, or the matching section of his full course.
career_outcomes: Write, compile and debug C programs
Use pointers, dynamic memory, structs and files safely
Build linked lists, stacks and queues
Foundation for C++, DSA, embedded and systems roles
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official docs, open-licence books, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted material re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Video minutes are real YouTube durations with the +15% rule applied (see goal.last_link_check). Mocks and the revision allowance remain planning figures.
